candidates.change_summary: Replace creation of EmergencyOracle using msg.sender with creation using address(this) so the owner passed to the new EmergencyOracle is the contract address instead of the caller.
Emit the event with the new oracle as the caller (msg.sender replaced by newOracle) so the logged owner differs from the original behavior.
Insert assignment to isAdmin for the newly created oracle, making the new oracle an admin and thus altering observable admin mapping state after creation.

Change the onlyAdmin modifier's require to check that msg.sender is NOT an admin (negate the condition), altering which callers can invoke newEmergencyOracle and thus the observable effect of who can create oracles.
